'''Tanner Cadaman''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] who represented his [[homeworld]], [[Feenix]], in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars]] he was an outspoken critic of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] in the media and joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group concerned with the chancellor's growing power.

Following the end of the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]], Cadaman attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] of Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. The [[Standard day|day]] after the formation of the Empire, Cadaman was [[Senatorial arrests|arrested]] by [[Imperial Intelligence]]. Incarcerated in the [[Arrth-Eno Prison Complex]] on the planet [[Coruscant]], Cadaman [[Death|perished]] around [[0 ABY]] when the [[prison]] was destroyed by Palpatine during a [[Arrth-Eno Mission|rescue]] attempt-turned [[assassin]]ation by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
===Outspoken senator===
Tanner Cadaman was a [[human]] [[Homeworld|from]] [[Feenix]], which he<ref name="Dawn" /> represented as a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Rebel Files" /> During the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Cadaman was one of the most outspoken critics of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] wartime leadership of the Republic, on occasions venting his dismay to the media. He joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group consisting of other senators concerned with Palpatine's accumalation of emergency powers during the war and the lack of a formal mechanism by which they could be removed.<ref name="Dawn" />

The delegation presented a [[Petition of 2,000|petition]] asking Palpatine to relinquish those powers during a session of the senate that proved to be the body's last meeting prior to its reformation into the [[Imperial Senate]] as part of the Republic's transformation into the [[Galactic Empire]] following the end of the Clone Wars<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Shortly after the formation of the Empire, Cadaman was among those who attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] of fellow senator and delegation member [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] in the [[city]] of [[Theed]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] where he marched with other senators in the procession behind her coffin.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Political prisoner===
{{Quote|Prison extraction failed. Total loss of life.|Davits Draven reports the death of Tanner Cadaman and others to Mon Mothma|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
The [[Standard day|day]] after the Empire was formed, Cadaman was [[Senatorial arrests|arrested]] by [[Imperial Intelligence]] alongside a number of other delegation members who were labeled as traitors in the [[HoloNet News]]. Cadaman was among those then incarcerated along with other political [[prisoner]]s in the [[Arrth-Eno Prison Complex]] on the planet [[Coruscant]]. Some among those members of the delegation who were not arrested went on to form the rebellious [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to [[Galactic Civil War|oppose]] the Empire. After the Alliance saw [[Assault on Cymoon|successes]] against the Empire on [[Cymoon 1]] and elsewhere<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Palpatine—by then [[Galactic Emperor]]—declared that all political prisoners at Arrth-Eno would be [[Death|executed]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

In order to try and save Cadaman and the other prisoners, rebel [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[General]] [[Davits Draven]] of [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Alliance Intelligence]] put together a [[Arrth-Eno Mission|mission]] in which undercover [[agent]] [[Eneb Ray]] would be activated in order to extract those in Arrth-Eno<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in around 0 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].<ref name="Death" /> Organa sent a summary of the mission to [[Mon Mothma]], a former senator and head of the Alliance, in which she mentioned looking forward to seeing Cadaman and others again soon. The reunion was not to be however, as Ray deviated from the plan in order to try and [[assassin]]ate Palpatine,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> ultimately resulting in the [[Emperor]] detonating a [[bomb]]<ref name="Timelines" /> that killed Cadaman<ref name="Death" /> and everyone else in the [[prison]]. The Empire then blamed their deaths on the rebels.<ref name="Timelines" /> Organa, who had believed she would have the chance to save Cadaman and the others in order to make up for not saving her homeworld of [[Alderaan]], was emotionally devastated by the mission's failure.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Personality and traits==
Tanner Cadaman had light skin and [[Color|gray]] [[hair]].<ref name="Dawn" />

==Equipment==
Cadaman wore a maroon [[Clothing|robe]].<ref name="Dawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tanner Cadaman appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The funeral scene that featured the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Cadaman was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the article "[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]," which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84]]<ref name="Insider84">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> on [[September 26]], 2005.<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> The article did not associate the name with the film character,<ref name="Insider84" /> with this connection being made in the [[Star Wars Insider 85|next issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' in Wallace's article "[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]],"<ref name="Insider85">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> which was published on [[November 28]], 2005.<ref name="Dates">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20051101.html|text=More Vader in ''Star Wars Insider'' #85}}</ref>
